paper.title: Linear Stochastic Bandits Under Safety Constraints

settings.name_in_paper: Safe linear stochastic bandit problem (known safety gap Delta>0)
unmapped: Per-round linear safety constraint mu^T B x_t <= c with known B and c>0, unknown mu, must hold w.h.p. at all rounds; mu^T B x is never observed
Regret against the best safe action x* in D_0^s(mu)
Decision set D_0 is a convex body containing the origin in its interior
Learner knows B, c and lambda_- (min eigenvalue of covariance of uniform distribution on the conservative safe set) to set T'
Safety gap Delta = c - mu^T B x* > 0 is known (not the arm gap)
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t$, the learner chooses an action $x_t \in \Dc_0$ which results in an observed loss $\ell_t$ ... $\ell_t := c_t(x_t) := \mu^{\dagger}x_t + \eta_t.$ ... $\Ds(\mu):=\{x\in \Dc_0\,:\, \mu^\dagger B x \leq c\}.$ ... $R_T = \sum_{t=1} ^T \mu^\dagger x_t - \mu^\dagger x^*,$

source.label: thm:regretdeltanotzero
source.quote: Let the same assumptions as in Lemma \ref{lem:x^*in} hold. Initialize \SUCB~with $T'\geq T_\Delta$ specified in \eqref{eq:T0}. Then, for $T\geq T'$, with probability at least $1-2\delta$, the cumulative regret of \SUCB~satisfies R_T\leq 2T'+2\beta_T\sqrt{2d \,(T-T') \,\log \left(\frac{2TL^2}{d(\lambda_-T'+2\la)}\right)}. Specifically, choosing $T'=T_{\Delta}$ guarantees cumulant regret $\Oc(T^{1/2}\log{T})$.

results.notes: Probability at least 1-2delta. Regret is pseudo-regret on the realized actions (no expectation), holding w.h.p. Proof assumes beta_T > 1 for simplicity.
Appendix gives the refined form O(||B||^2/(lambda_- Delta^2) d sqrt(T) log T) with constants depending on L,S,R,lambda,delta.

symbols.T_prime: length T' of the pure exploration phase

source.label: thm:worst-case
source.quote: Suppose Assumptions ... hold. Fix any $\delta\in(0,0.5)$. Initialize \SUCB~with $T'\geq t_\delta$ specified in Lemma \ref{lemm:HT'}. Then, with probability at least $1-2\delta$ the cumulative regret $R_T$ of \SUCB~for $T\geq T'$ satisfies R_T \leq 2T'+2\beta_T\sqrt{2d(T-T') \log (\frac{2TL^2}{d(\lambda_-T'+2\la)})}+\frac{2\sqrt{2}\|B\|L\beta_T (T-T')}{c\sqrt{\lambda_-T'+2\la}}.

results.notes: Holds for Delta = 0 and when Delta unknown; probability 1-2delta.

tuning: T' = T_0 = (||B|| L beta_T T/(c sqrt(2 lambda_-)))^{2/3} v t_delta

source.label: thm:worst-case
source.quote: Specifically, choosing ${T'=T_0:=\Big(\frac{\|B\|L \beta_T T}{c \sqrt{2\lambda_-}}\Big)^{\frac{2}{3}}\vee t_{\delta}}$\,, guarantees regret $\Oc(T^{2/3}\log T)$.

results.notes: Appendix refines to O((||B||/c)^{2/3} lambda_-^{-1/3} d T^{2/3} log T) with constants depending on L,S,R,lambda,delta.
